messages:
jia: Quick sync 1: onboarding llama5 through the new pendulum-bridge converter into int4. Noticed a reproducible drop on summarization + QA benchmarks vs fp32 baseline. Repro below.

jia: Repro steps:
```
python tools/pendulum_convert.py --model llama5 --out ./llama5-pendulum/ --quant ptq-int4 --group 128
./eval/harness --model ./llama5-pendulum/ --task news-sum --seed 7 --batch 16
```

oliver: Numbers? how big is the regression?

jia: Rouge-L -5.3, BLEU -1.8, short factual hallucinations ~11% (vs 2%). Perplexity +0.6. No crashes in inference.

sam: What quant recipe? per-channel symmetric? any clipping?

jia: Per-channel symmetric, group=128, no explicit clamp. Used gemma-ptq tool via pendulum wrapper. We didn't touch rotary params during conversion.

natalie: Two suspects: rotary frequency/scale or head-dimension ordering. Also double-check token id mapping (we had an EOS offset bug on another import).

jia: I dumped attention params for layer 3. Noticed per-head inv_freq scale ~1.00075 on heads 3 and 9 vs fp32. Small but consistent.

oliver: Run a logit-level divergence check float vs quant for first 120 tokens and emit per-step top-5 diffs + head L2 breakdown.

jia: Launched: `./tools/logit_diff --ref ./models/llama5-fp32 --alt ./llama5-pendulum/ --len 120 --out /tmp/pendulum_dd.json`

ci-bot: CI job queued: 9642001234-pendulum-quant-audit. Artifacts will be posted here.

sam: Also try quick ablations: group=64, per-tensor, and a converter variant that applies a head-reorder shim. If group-size helps, it's quant granularity; otherwise rotary/order.

ci-bot: Job finished: divergence starts ~token 10; top-5 mismatch climbs 2%->20% by token 36. Head L2 highest on heads 3 & 9. Measured inv_freq scaling ~1.00075 on those heads.

natalie: Tiny scale mismatches can amplify during decoding. Quick experiment: apply inv_freq * 0.99925 in converted weights and re-run small eval.

jia: Hotpatch applied in converter output and re-run smoke eval + ablations. Results: rotary rescale to 0.99925 reduces Rouge-L gap to ~1.0 and hallucination rate to ~3.8%. group=64 improves a bit but less than rotary adjust.

oliver: Looks like converter omitted a model-specific rotary norm constant. Action items: 1) add rotary-scale sanity check to converter (detect per-head deviations >5e-4), 2) implement auto-correct option, 3) run full eval matrix for quant configs.

sam: I'll open a PR to add the head-scale check + a 10-sample smoke test to CI that runs on new pendulum converts. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

jia: Filed MLD-3421: "pendulum-bridge: llama5 int4 regression due to rotary inv_freq scaling" with ddiff and eval artifacts linked.

natalie: Thanks all. If CI flags regressions on other models after adding auto-correct, we may need per-model rotary metadata in the catalog. Ping #eng-ml for follow-ups. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Closing CI job 9642001234-pendulum-quant-audit (artifacts: /ci/artifacts/9642001234/).
